text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Pulmonary Embolism. Your recent upper respiratory infection, combined with unexplained shortness of breath, exertional dyspnea, and an unremarkable chest CT, raises a high suspicion for a pulmonary embolism despite the normal D-dimer reading; the negative workup so far may be insufficient, so we should consider a Ventilation/Perfusion (V/Q) scan or repeat imaging to rule out a small clot.
